endpoint_separation: LIVE FINDING evidence (contact/reduction), OFFLINE DETECTOR evidence (none in this experiment -- no openpyxl replay for decisions), and OFFICIAL SCORE evidence (capability) must never substitute for one another. Detector precision is already established; this experiment tests only the closed repair loop.

mandatory_guard.definition: paired official regression-accuracy delta (treatment minus control, per task)
mandatory_guard.name: paired regression-accuracy delta
mandatory_guard.rationale: feedback is not useful if the agent clears errors by damaging unrelated cells (cf. 10_02 clear_range repair, which deleted error cells).
mandatory_guard.rule: any credible regression harm vetoes a PROMISING read even if modification improves; see proposed_discovery_gates.json

mechanism_endpoints.absolute_live_new_error_reduction: (live NFE at first report) minus (live NFE at final submission), treatment arm; computed by invisible harness recalc at both points
mechanism_endpoints.agent_response_rate: fraction of contacted trajectories with any agent action referencing the report (read of a shown cell, edit touching a shown cell, or explicit mention) before trajectory end
mechanism_endpoints.calls_consumed_after_report: model calls used after the report episode (diagnoses budget effects)
mechanism_endpoints.finding_count_at_first_report: live NFE count that triggered the episode
mechanism_endpoints.fraction_of_shown_findings_absent_at_fin: of the <=80 shown representatives, fraction no longer erroring in the final submission (mechanical repair check, same engine)
mechanism_endpoints.new_errors_introduced_after_report: live NFE present at final that were absent at report time (repair overshoot)
mechanism_endpoints.repair_write_rate_after_report: fraction of contacted trajectories with >=1 saving write after the report
mechanism_endpoints.submission_rate: fraction submitted via tool (vs autosubmit/cap) per arm
mechanism_endpoints.treatment_contact_rate: fraction of treatment trajectories that received the report episode (fired at least once)

primary_capability_endpoint.definition: paired official modification-accuracy delta (treatment minus control, per task), mean over primary population with per-task deltas and leave-one-task-out
primary_capability_endpoint.name: paired official modification-accuracy delta
primary_capability_endpoint.rationale: the mechanism is supposed to help repair incorrect workbook modifications; modification accuracy is the direct official measure of that

secondary.exact_success: paired exact-success delta (secondary ONLY; do not gate a small discovery population on exact -- Debugging exact is ~0 throughout history and a single conversion would dominate)
